newsitem.title: UK: MoD to allow BAe, GEC alliance - paper.
newsitem.headline: MoD to allow BAe, GEC alliance - paper.

text.p: Britain's Ministry of Defence has dropped its opposition to a defence-equipment alliance between British Aerospace Plc and GEC Plc, the Sunday Times newspaper said.
The paper said this will renew speculation about an eventual deal between the two, although nothing is expected before next year at the earliest.
According to the article, the MoD has argued over a link-up between BAe's Defence arm and GEC's Marconi electronics on the basis that it would create a vertically integrated monopoly.

The Sunday Times cited industry insiders saying that it is ready to countenance a deal because of a series of recent developments, including the accelerating pace of restructuring in the world defence industry.
A spokesman for British Aerospace dismissed the report as "yet another Sunday speculation" and said the company declined further comment.
